{"consolidated_memory":"SIGNATURE MISMATCH IN KEY ROTATION (crypto/keys/rotation.py) — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

**Incident 1 — 2026-07-21**
File: crypto/keys/rotation.py (security domain)
Affected: Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
Signal: Verification failure against the previous key
Root cause: Off-by-one error in slice bound
Fix: Corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
PR: #4427 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-1
Reproduction: Rotate the signing key while requests are in flight
Test coverage: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py (Python stack)
Result: Error rate dropped from 3.6% to under 8 per ten thousand (0.08%)

**Incident 2 — 2026-08-04**
File: crypto/keys/rotation.py (security domain)
Affected: Occurred only after client had already retried once
Problem: Signature mismatch in key rotation
Signal: Verification failure against the previous key
Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR: #8754 on branch fix/signature-mismatch-2
Reproduction: Rotate the signing key while requests are in flight
Test coverage: tests/crypto/test_rotation.py (Python stack)
Result: Job execution time improved from 8 hours to 26 minutes

**Shared characteristics:**
- Both file: crypto/keys/rotation.py
- Both security-related
- Both involve signature mismatch in key rotation
- Both have same signal: verification failure against previous key
- Both reproduce with: signing key rotation while requests are in flight
- Both covered by tests/crypto/test_rotation.py"}
